evidence_rules: The 1907 Fiji Open and 1934 association foundation establish deep competition/institutional tradition but do not directly measure nationwide participation or elite player quality.
Pre-1970 ratings refer to current Fiji territory under colonial governance; post-1970 ratings use independent Fiji.
The 2022 regional junior championships are gated to 2022 as development/competition evidence.
The current Lautoka/Nadi/Suva club network is gated to 2026 and not backcast.
No tournament result or ranking is used as a calibration target; 9+ remains world-leading.
